::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [23 July 1873]  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell/14
:::

[To [Wilhelmina Martha James](people/person_754.qmd)]

It is coming, but there were so many that we are obliged to send them to the post by instalments
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** A printed postcard, addressed on reverse to ‘Miss W M James/ Clarghyll Hall/ Alston/ Carlisle’ and postmarked 23 July 1873.  James was a novelist, who contributed a story called 'Coin of the Realm' to the *MP* Christmas number of 1874 under her usual pseudonym 'Austin Clare'.  However, this enigmatic message does not seem to relate to that.
